messages:
Lexi (Support): Marta from Acme sent a ticket: their API calls suddenly started getting 503s and >400ms p99 latency. They say traffic shows routing to eu-west but their account is pinned to us-west. Billing spike noticed too. Can oncall take?
Marta (Customer): Confirming — we saw requests routed to ams-01 and the token validation failed intermittently. Downtime for ~6m and then traffic fell back. Our logs show 'auth: token expired' on some requests.
Jamal (Oncall): I'm looking. getting heartbeat alerts: deploy-bot posted multiple probe flaps for region eu-west-2 around the same timeframe. @Priya can you pull probe logs?
deploy-bot: [alert] probe-healthcheck eu-west-2: UP->DOWN->UP (3 events) service:api-proxy, window: 5m, correlation_id: c1f7b9
Priya (eng-sre): grabbing probe logs. Initial glance: healthcheck agent reported connection reset from a subset of probe IPs. I see keepalive timeouts around 1956781000-1956781100. Could be NAT rotation on provider side causing ephemeral IP changes.
Theo (eng-platform): Noted. We recently rolled a small routing policy change to prefer nearest-region fallback on congestion — might've changed failover thresholds. Scheduling info: rollout ID r-2026-03-14-evict-bias, started 1956779000.
Jamal (Oncall): Repro steps from customer? Marta, can you paste a curl/trace that fails?
Marta (Customer): Here's a failing trace id: trace=TRC-7a9f. Sample curl that failed intermittently:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
```
Response: HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
{ "error": "temporarily_unavailable", "detail": "upstream: no healthy host" }

Lexi (Support): Also they attached billing spike screenshot — a few hundred dollars in a 30m window due to retries. They think retries + cross-region latency caused cost OoB.
Priya (eng-sre): I pulled the agent logs for the customer tenant. Their healthcheck TTL for probes is set to 30s; combined with the quicker fallback policy, the routing decision flipped after 2 consecutive fail checks. But the probe agent was reporting false negatives because of intermittent packet loss from provider NAT.
Jamal (Oncall): Hypothesis: provider NAT rotation + aggressive fallback threshold -> quick cross-region failover -> auth tokens validated in wrong region causing token verification to fail sporadically -> client retries -> billing spike.
Theo (eng-platform): Steps: 1) Temporarily increase backend healthcheck grace window for affected tenant to 90s, 2) suppress automated cross-region failovers for tenant (use hold flag), 3) rollback the fallback aggressiveness in rollout r-2026-03-14 for the next canary batch. Can someone run the suppression?
Priya (eng-sre): I'll apply hold flag to tenant acme-corp-42 now and bump healthcheck grace. Commands:
```
# suppress auto-failover for tenant
rwctl tenant update acme-corp-42 --failover-policy hold
# increase probe grace
rwctl probes update --tenant acme-corp-42 --grace 90s
```
Priya (eng-sre): Done. Changes propagated to control plane. ops-bot shows policy=hold and grace=90s.
ops-bot: [policy] tenant acme-corp-42 failover_policy=hold applied by priya (eng-sre) at 1956781220
Jamal (Oncall): Good. Marta, can you re-run your curl and confirm routing/latency? Also, please collect a new trace if it reproduces.
Marta (Customer): Re-tested at 1956781250 — calls now steady to us-west, p99 ~65ms, no 503s so far. Will monitor for 1hr. Thanks for the quick change.
Lexi (Support): Filing follow-up: check rollout config and provider NAT churn with network team. Also need a billing review for retry charges. @Theo can you schedule a short rollback plan?
Theo (eng-platform): I'll queue a rollback of fallback aggressiveness for rollout r-2026-03-14 for the remaining canaries and open a PR to adjust default probe grace to 60s. Will coordinate with infra.
Priya (eng-sre): For long-term: propose detection rule to correlate probe IP churn with failover events and mark as "probe-flap" to avoid auto-failing regions quickly. Also recommend token validation be region-agnostic where possible (persist claim sources).
Jamal (Oncall): Agreed. Also add a short-term mitigation to reduce client-side retry storm: recommend clients use exponential backoff + jitter. Lexi pls add to customer guidance.
Lexi (Support): On it. I'll send a postmortem to Marta + internal incident note with root cause and mitigations. Closing the escalation if no more issues after 1h. :thumbsup:
Marta (Customer): Thanks everyone, appreciate the quick response.
Theo (eng-platform): Follow-up tasks: #1 rollback fallback aggressiveness (P0) #2 PR default probe grace=60s (P1) #3 billing credits review with finance (P1). I'll create tickets.
Priya (eng-sre): I'll draft the probe-flap detection rules and a short runbook for oncall.
Jamal (Oncall): If it flaps again, alert level -> incidents channel. For now monitoring.
lexi (Support): thread archived when resolved."
